device: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra unfolded
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: exactly one high-fidelity, shippable native Android app screenshot for an unfolded Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra
Primary request: Design MealOS active cooking mode for “Garlic-herb chicken + baby potatoes + broccoli,” with serving mode “Dinner + lunch tomorrow.”
Canvas: 2504 × 2256 pixels, near-square landscape, full-bleed app UI only, no physical device frame or bezel.
Platform and interaction: Fluent native Android, modern Material 3 structure and components, edge-to-edge composition, 48dp minimum touch targets, clear accessible hierarchy, realistic Android status/navigation affordances kept subtle. This must read as an operational cooking app surface, not concept art or a decorative poster.
Layout: Equal-weight two-pane layout split around the vertical fold hinge. Add a slim adaptive navigation rail on the far left with recognizable Material-style line icons and the text labels “Today”, “Plan”, “Recipes”, “Grocery”; Today is active. The left cooking pane is dominated by a large current step, “Step 2 of 5”, with an unmistakable next action and visible linear progress. Use this exact core copy: “Season the chicken” and “Coat chicken with garlic, herbs, salt, pepper, and 1 tbsp olive oil.” Include a large primary action labeled “Next step”. The right pane shows scaled ingredients for “Dinner + lunch tomorrow” and two clearly live timers. Include verbatim ingredient text such as “Chicken thighs 680 g”, “Baby potatoes 600 g”, “Broccoli 340 g”, “Garlic 4 cloves”, and “Olive oil 2 tbsp”. Include timer rows labeled exactly “Potatoes” with “12:48” and “Chicken” with “08:20”, with clear pause controls.
Visual direction: Butcher-Paper Prep Map. One continuous warm butcher-paper working sheet fills the entire screen; do not place the world inside floating cards. Dark espresso modern Android typography. Tomato-red grease-pencil marks for progress, active state, hand-drawn circles, and restrained annotations. Muted herb-green and steel-blue accents for supporting state and timers. Sparse masking-tape tabs function as practical labels. A restrained brushed-steel vertical hinge seam separates the panes without becoming ornamental.
Composition and hierarchy: Calm, adult, highly readable at a glance from a kitchen counter. Generous spacing, large step typography, tabular timer numerals, strong contrast. Physical-paper texture remains subtle enough to protect legibility. Panels are organized by rules, alignment, tape labels, and tonal ink zones rather than rounded card stacks. Equal visual weight across the two cooking panes; navigation rail remains secondary.
Exact visible text, spelled and rendered verbatim with no invented labels or filler:
“MealOS”
“Today”
“Plan”
“Recipes”
“Grocery”
“Dinner + lunch tomorrow”
“Step 2 of 5”
“Season the chicken”
“Coat chicken with garlic, herbs, salt, pepper, and 1 tbsp olive oil.”
“Next step”
“Ingredients”
“Chicken thighs 680 g”
“Baby potatoes 600 g”
“Broccoli 340 g”
“Garlic 4 cloves”
“Olive oil 2 tbsp”
“Timers”
“Potatoes”
“12:48”
“Chicken”
“08:20”
Constraints: Exactly one full-screen screenshot. No food photography. No people. No mock device, bezel, hands, tabletop, surrounding scene, perspective tilt, or presentation board. No floating dashboard cards, glassmorphism, glossy gradients, excessive shadows, playful children’s styling, illegible handwriting, placeholder text, lorem ipsum, watermarks, logos other than the plain MealOS wordmark, nutrition or health claims, or invented product claims. Preserve the near-square unfolded proportion and a believable central hinge-safe layout.
